crossRefs.note: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.

Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother’s brothers, and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,
translations.bsb: Now Abimelech son of Jerubbaal went to his mother’s brothers at Shechem and said to them and to all the clan of his mother,
translations.kjv: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,
translations.asv: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and spake with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,
